title: Effect of SPS sintering temperature on the microstructure and mechanical properties of the WNbTaVTi refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by ball milling high-purity W, Nb, Ta, V and Ti powders for 24 hours with a ball-to-powder ratio of 5:1 at 300 rpm, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1400°C under 30 MPa pressure with a heating rate of 100°C/min
